name: Catalonia: C-16 tolls (Túnel del Cadí, Túnels de Vallvidrera, les Fonts, Sant Vicenç de Castellet)
law: The Generalitat de Catalunya's toll rates for 2026 (yearly revision by Resolució under Decret 465/2004), category 4 (trucks with more than four wheels, or three axles; trucks over 3.5 t are taken to be), per passage either way, excluding 21% IVA: the Túnel del Cadí; the Túnels de Vallvidrera at the off-peak price (weekdays 7:30-10:30 and 17:00-21:00 cost more, priced off-peak with a note); the C-16 barriers of les Fonts (the weekday price only with Via-T or Satelise, so `etc`; else and at weekends the full price) and Sant Vicenç de Castellet (weekday and weekend prices; public holidays aren't modelled). The C-16 Manresa barrier and the C-32 barriers have no named booths in OpenStreetMap and aren't priced.

sources.title: Generalitat de Catalunya: Tarifes de peatges 2026

tolled_roads: C-16 Túnel del Cadí, Túnels de Vallvidrera, and the barriers of les Fonts (Sant Cugat-Terrassa) and Sant Vicenç de Castellet (Terrassa-Manresa).
